name: diagram-design
description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: A set of 38 professionally-styled diagram templates that AI coding assistants can use to draw clean charts and diagrams instead of messy default ones.
buyer: A technical writer, startup founder, or content marketer who needs polished diagrams for docs, pitch decks, or blog posts but has no design skill and doesn't want generic-looking auto-generated charts.
business_use_cases: A startup founder uses it to generate clean architecture and process diagrams for investor decks without hiring a designer.
A technical writer uses it to standardize all diagrams across product documentation so they look consistent and professional.
A content agency offers 'AI-diagram-illustrated' blog posts to clients as a value-add service using this as the visual engine.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid diagram-generation service: clients describe a process, you generate polished diagrams with this toolkit and deliver them.
Build a simple hosted web app around it so non-technical users can generate diagrams without running Claude Code themselves, billed per diagram or monthly.

steal_this: This weekend, build a 'describe your process, get a polished diagram' web tool on top of this template set and sell single diagrams for a few dollars each.
